compatibility.reason: The migration contract, verifier, tests, and guide must name legacy inputs explicitly.
compatibility.removal_condition: Retain while any supported legacy alias or historical repository redirect exists.

compatibility.reason: Supported legacy environment keys are parsed only by tested compatibility boundaries.
compatibility.removal_condition: Remove after the documented compatibility window and observed legacy-use count reach zero.

compatibility.reason: The repository migration record must identify both ends of the completed rename.
compatibility.removal_condition: Retain permanently as an operational migration record.

historical.reason: Signed and timestamped evidence preserves the identity under which it was produced.
historical.removal_condition: Never rewrite; supersede with new evidence when a new run occurs.

historical.reason: Patch payloads and their paths are immutable source provenance.
historical.removal_condition: Retain for as long as the corresponding source or release is supported.

external.reason: Vendored source identity is controlled by its upstream project.
external.removal_condition: Change only through an independently verified upstream update.
